name: Seafood Platter
description:
(Fish) You can place up to 3 cards from your Deck on top of your Deck in any order, then, once this turn, you can Normal Summon/Set 1 monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set this turn.
(Squid) You can add 1 Ritual Spell or 1 Ritual Monster from your GY to your hand.
(Sushi) The next time you activate a Ritual Spell this turn: you can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, and if you excavate a Ritual Monster, you can Ritual Summon that monster instead. Shuffle the rest back into the Deck.

name: "Leftovers"
description:
(Rotten Tomatoes) You can banish 1 Zombie or Fiend from your GY; draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
(Microplastics) You can send 1 Zombie or Fiend type monster from your Deck to the GY.
(Brown Beef) 1 monster your opponent controls loses ATK/DEF equal to the number of Ritual Monsters you control x 500.

name: British "Person"
description:
(Bangers n’ Mash) This turn, your Ritual Monsters gain 100 ATK for each non-effect monster in your GY.
(Sunday Roast) You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower non-Effect monster from your Deck.
(Beans on Toast) For the rest of the Duel, if you draw a non-effect monster for your normal draw, you can reveal it and draw a card (you can only gain this effect once per Duel).
